task_instance: Generate a risk-based ISO 27001 ISMS annual audit plan for a sample set of 10 Annex A controls (per the SKILL's Risk-Based Audit Schedule table: Critical=Quarterly, High=Semi-annual, Medium/Low=Annual), validate it covers all controls, and document one sample audit finding using the SKILL's Finding Documentation Template.
evidence: Created controls.csv (10 sample Annex A controls with risk levels). Wrote audit_scheduler.py implementing the SKILL.md 'Risk-Based Audit Schedule' table (Critical=Quarterly, High=Semi-annual, Medium/Low=Annual) since the SKILL's own referenced scripts/isms_audit_scheduler.py lives outside the allowed read scope for this task. Ran `python3 audit_scheduler.py --year 2026 --controls controls.csv --output audit_plan.json --format json` and again with --format markdown; both runs printed 'VALIDATION PASSED: all 10 controls covered by the plan.' and produced audit_plan.json and audit_plan.md, each listing every control with its assigned frequency and 2026 scheduled dates (verified by parsing audit_plan.json and re-listing all 10 control_ids, and by inspecting audit_plan.md's table). Also wrote finding_ISMS-2026-001.txt, a sample nonconformity finding (control A.8.16, log retention below policy) following the SKILL's exact Finding Documentation Template fields; verified all 7 required template fields (Finding ID, Control Reference, Severity, Evidence, Risk Impact, Root Cause, Recommendation) are present via grep. All files exist in the work directory: controls.csv, audit_scheduler.py, audit_plan.json, audit_plan.md, finding_ISMS-2026-001.txt. No external tools, credentials, or network access were needed for this core deliverable (audit planning + findings documentation), since it is fundamentally a reasoning/document-generation task.
